Subject: SIG/CAIQ: CrystalTech BCP onboarding & RTO/RPO evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the intro during procurement. CrystalTech's Security & Resilience team is starting our SIG/CAIQ review of Redwood for the upcoming contract. As part of our BCP/DR checks we need a compact set of artifacts we can include in our package:

- RTO and RPO commitments by service with evidence/measurement (recent snapshots or test logs).
- Runbook or operational playbook for failover of inference traffic (high-level steps + owners).
- Evidence of KV cache warm/start snapshots (we're particularly interested in cold->warm recovery times).
- Tabletop/test schedule and last tabletop date + summary.
- Any SOC2 control references that map to DR controls (control IDs or short mapping).

Can you confirm what you can deliver and an ETA? Our procurement target to close is 2026-09-15, so it would be ideal to have materials by 2026-09-09.

If helpful, we can accept redacted artifacts.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Dir., Security & Resilience
CrystalTech
[ogrant@crystaltech.com]

[Attachment: CrystalTech_SIG_template.xlsx (requested questionnaire)]

- Runbook excerpt (operational playbook with owner contacts and escape hatch) — will attach runbook_operational_playbook.pdf by EOD Monday (2026-08-31).
- Tabletop/test summary: we'll include the last tabletop date, agenda, and a short after-action note.

Quick clarifying Qs: any particular format you prefer for the RTO measurements (CSV is fine but we can also provide a short narrative)? Also confirm whether redaction of IP addresses is acceptable.

We'll target an internal delivery milestone of 2026-09-02 and final handover to you by 2026-09-07 to leave room for follow-ups. If that works i'll mark this as priority with Marissa and Karthik.

Best,
